title: I bought a tileset and it doesnt fit rpg maker mz

posts.author: spades141
posts.body:
RPG Buildings and Interriors WINDMILL by Szadi art.
szadiart.itch.io
this is the tileset i bought. these looked great and once i uploaded them they did not fit.
idk if i can post them here or not but is there a way for me to resize them. i tried to message them but its been half a day and ive been messing with it for atleast 3 hours in gimp. resizing and still cant get it to fit right. any ideas that can help me?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Well of course it doesn't fit. The tileset is 32x32 while rpg maker's default tile size is 48x48. So you'd have to upscale it to that.
Alternatively, RPG Maker MZ has settings to get it to use 32x32 tiles instead, although that means all your other tiles need to be that too.

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body: If you want to resize it, you'll need a factor of exactly 150% (just choose % from the px menu and type in 150 in both dimensions). It looks like just that alone should work, though I don't know how good it would look.

posts.author: fizzly
posts.body: You need to change Tile Size on System 2 tab in database to 32x32 first. Also it does not say that these assets are RPG Maker ready, so you probably need to build the tilesets from this on your own.

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body: Yes, that's a good point – scaling it up by 3x but then treating each original tile as 4 tiles would probably look better.
